manifest.purpose: Hardened implementation of `int assemble_packet(const unsigned char *header, unsigned short header_len, const unsigned char *payload, unsigned short payload_len, unsigned char *dest, unsigned short dest_capacity)` matching packet_assemble.h exactly (unchanged signature). Fix: compute total = (unsigned int)header_len + (unsigned int)payload_len (widened arithmetic, no 16-bit wrap since max is 131070 which fits in unsigned int). Compare total > (unsigned int)dest_capacity; if true return -1 without touching dest. Otherwise copy header_len bytes then payload_len bytes into dest using loops bounded by the original unsigned short lengths (never by the wrapped narrow sum), and return (int)total. Handles header_len=0/payload_len=0/dest_capacity=0 without crashing (loops simply don't execute, no null deref since count is 0). No dynamic allocation. Includes "packet_assemble.h" only, no main(). Satisfies FR1-FR4 and SR1-SR3, and prevents CWE-190/680/787/131 wraparound overflow.
